title: Gonstead.X (Series 13) — Mount Horeb Cell
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO world set in Mount Horeb, Wisconsin, the Driftless village of the Gonstead Clinic. Agents synthesize evidence and draft proposals across five zones; humans alone vote and enact.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model and measurable outcomes

districts.real_anchor: Mt Horeb Depot - Military Ridge Trail & Tourist Center
Mount Horeb Chamber of Commerce Welcome Center
Driftless Historium & Mount Horeb Area Historical Museum

court.name: The Military Ridge Court
court.style: Driftless prairie civic square with limestone edge and telegraph-line motif
court.why_here: Sited by the old Mt Horeb Depot on the Military Ridge Trail, the village's historic rail-to-trail spine, fitting a cell that routes tasks and signals progress.

quests.title: Set the Focus (Pending Stewards)
steps: Read the charter wall and note the focus gap
Carry the focus-pending placard to the Evidence Annex
Ask Evidence Monitor to summarize what a focus choice needs
Return the summary brief to Charter Hall for human stewards

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect a citation packet from the Evidence Stacks
Deliver it to Research Synthesis Agent in the Synthesis Studio
Hand the synthesis to Proposal & Grant Drafter at the lectern
Verify the enactment door stays sealed — only humans enact

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Take the comment scrolls from the Debate Floor
Deliver them to Task Router at the Routing Depot
Watch tasks sorted into working-group pigeonholes
Confirm Collaborator Scout has pinned three candidate experts

quests.title: Measure What Matters
steps: Fetch the decision-cycle calendar from the Routing Depot
Log completed working-group tasks at the Progress Tower
Let Progress Tracker update the outcomes wall chart
Light the signal lantern when a milestone is met

quests.title: The Human Hand
steps: Audit one milestone in the Milestone Gallery
Note any reserved-power action on the ledger telescope
Carry the audit almanac to Charter Hall
Deposit it for stewards; observe the voting urn is never touched by agents
